verses.en: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
verses.pt: Assim esta é a lei da expiação da culpa: é coisa muito santa.
verses.en_web: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering. It is most holy.
verses.en_bbe: And this is the law of the offering for wrongdoing: it is most holy.

verses.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.pt: No lugar onde degolarem o holocausto, degolarão o sacrifício pela culpa; e espargirá seu sangue em derredor sobre o altar:
verses.en_web: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.
verses.en_bbe: They are to put to death the offering for wrongdoing in the same place as the burned offering; and the priest is to put the blood on and round the altar.

verses.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.pt: E dela oferecerá toda a sua gordura, a cauda, e a gordura que cobre os intestinos.
verses.en_web: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,
verses.en_bbe: And all the fat of it, the fat tail and the fat covering the inside parts, is to be given as an offering.

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.pt: E os dois rins, e a gordura que está sobre eles, e o que está sobre os lombos; e com os rins tirará o redenho de sobre o fígado.
verses.en_web: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away;
verses.en_bbe: And the two kidneys, and the fat on them, which is by the top of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away:

verses.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
verses.pt: E o sacerdote o fará arder sobre o altar; oferta acesa ao SENHOR: é expiação da culpa.
verses.en_web: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.
verses.en_bbe: They are to be burned by the priest on the altar for an offering made by fire to the Lord: it is an offering for wrongdoing.

verses.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
verses.pt: Todo homem dentre os sacerdotes a comerá: será comida no lugar santo: é coisa muito santa.
verses.en_web: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.
verses.en_bbe: Every male among the priests may have it as food in a holy place: it is most holy.

verses.en: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
verses.pt: Como a expiação pelo pecado, assim é a expiação da culpa: uma mesma lei terão: será do sacerdote que haverá feito a reconciliação com ela.
verses.en_web: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.
verses.en_bbe: As is the sin-offering, so is the offering for wrongdoing; there is one law for them: the priest who makes the offering to take away sin, he is to have it.

verses.en: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.pt: E o sacerdote que oferecer holocausto de alguém, o couro do holocausto que oferecer, será para ele.
verses.en_web: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.
verses.en_bbe: And the priest offering any man's burned offering for him, may have the skin of the burned offering which is offered by him.

verses.en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.
verses.pt: Também toda oferta de cereais que se cozer em forno, e tudo o que for preparado em panela, ou em frigideira, será do sacerdote que o oferecer.
verses.en_web: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is dressed in the pan, and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.
verses.en_bbe: And every meal offering which is cooked in the oven and everything made in a cooking pot or on a flat plate, is for the priest by whom it is offered.

verses.en: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
verses.pt: E toda oferta de cereais amassada com azeite, e seca, será de todos os filhos de Arão, tanto ao um como ao outro.
verses.en_web: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.
verses.en_bbe: And every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, is for all the sons of Aaron in equal measure.

verses.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.
verses.pt: E esta é a lei do sacrifício pacífico, que se oferecerá ao SENHOR:
verses.en_web: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And this is the law for the peace-offerings offered to the Lord.

verses.en: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.pt: Se se oferecer em ação de graças, oferecerá por sacrifício de ação de graças tortas sem levedura amassadas com azeite, e massas sem levedura untadas com azeite, e boa farinha frita em tortas amassadas com azeite.
verses.en_web: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.
verses.en_bbe: If any man gives his offering as a praise-offering, then let him give with the offering, unleavened cakes mixed with oil and thin unleavened cakes covered with oil and cakes of the best meal well mixed with oil.

verses.en: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.pt: Com tortas de pão levedado oferecerá sua oferta no seu sacrifício pacífico de ação de graças.
verses.en_web: With cakes of leavened bread he shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving.
verses.en_bbe: With his peace-offering let him give cakes of leavened bread, as a praise-offering.

verses.en: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.pt: E de toda a oferta apresentará uma parte para oferta elevada ao SENHOR, e será do sacerdote que espargir o sangue das ofertas pacíficas.
verses.en_web: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.en_bbe: And let him give one out of every offering to be lifted up before the Lord; that it may be for the priest who puts the blood of the peace-offering on the altar.

verses.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.pt: E a carne do sacrifício de suas ofertas pacíficas em ação de graças, se comerá no dia que for oferecida: não deixarão dela nada para outro dia.
verses.en_web: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.en_bbe: And the flesh of the praise-offering is to be taken as food on the day when it is offered; no part of it may be kept till the morning.

verses.en: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.pt: Mas se o sacrifício de sua oferta for voto, ou voluntário, no dia que oferecer seu sacrifício será comido; e o que dele restar, será comido no dia seguinte:
verses.en_web: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice; and on the next day what remains of it shall be eaten:
verses.en_bbe: But if his offering is made because of an oath or given freely, it may be taken as food on the day when it is offered; and the rest may be used up on the day after:

verses.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.pt: E o que restar para o terceiro dia da carne do sacrifício, será queimado no fogo.
verses.en_web: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
verses.en_bbe: But if any of the flesh of the offering is still unused on the third day, it is to be burned with fire.

verses.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.pt: E se se comer da carne do sacrifício de suas pazes no terceiro dia, o que o oferecer não será aceito, nem lhe será imputado; abominação será, e a pessoa que dele comer levará seu pecado.
verses.en_web: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it shall not be credited to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: And if any of the flesh of the peace-offering is taken as food on the third day, it will not be pleasing to God and will not be put to the account of him who gives it; it will be unclean and a cause of sin to him who takes it as food.

verses.en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.pt: E a carne que tocar a alguma coisa impura, não se comerá; ao fogo será queimada; mas qualquer limpo comerá desta carne.
verses.en_web: “‘The meat that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the meat, everyone who is clean may eat it;
verses.en_bbe: And flesh touched by any unclean thing may not be taken for food: it is to be burned with fire; and as for the flesh of the peace-offerings, everyone who is clean may take it as food:

verses.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.pt: E a pessoa que comer a carne do sacrifício pacífico, o qual é do SENHOR, estando impura, aquela pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.
verses.en_web: but the soul who eats of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.en_bbe: But he who is unclean when he takes as food the flesh of the peace-offerings, which are the Lord's, will be cut off from his people.

verses.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.pt: Além disso, a pessoa que tocar alguma coisa impura, em impureza de homem, ou em animal impuro, ou em qualquer abominação impura, e comer a carne do sacrifício pacífico, o qual é do SENHOR, aquela pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.
verses.en_web: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
verses.en_bbe: And anyone who, after touching any unclean thing of man or an unclean beast or any unclean and disgusting thing, takes as food the flesh of the peace-offerings, which are the Lord's, will be cut off from his people.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Falou ainda o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Nenhuma gordura de boi, nem de cordeiro, nem de cabra, comereis.
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel: You are not to take any fat, of ox or sheep or goat, for food.

verses.en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.pt: A gordura de animal morto naturalmente, e a gordura do que foi arrebatado de feras, se preparará para qualquer outro uso, mas não o comereis.
verses.en_web: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.
verses.en_bbe: And the fat of that which comes to a natural death, and the fat of that which is attacked by beasts, may be used for other purposes, but not in any way for food.

verses.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.pt: Porque qualquer um que comer gordura de animal, do qual se oferece ao SENHOR oferta acesa, a pessoa que o comer, será cortada de seus povos.
verses.en_web: For whoever eats the fat of the animal, of which men offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.en_bbe: For anyone who takes as food the fat of any beast of which men make an offering by fire to the Lord, will be cut off from his people.

verses.en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.pt: Além disso, nenhum sangue comereis em todas as vossas habitações, tanto de aves como de animais.
verses.en_web: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
verses.en_bbe: And you are not to take for food any blood, of bird or of beast, in any of your houses.

verses.en: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.pt: Qualquer um pessoa que comer algum sangue, a tal pessoa será eliminada de seus povos.
verses.en_web: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”
verses.en_bbe: Whoever takes any blood for food will be cut off from his people.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.pt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: O que oferecer sacrifício de suas pazes ao SENHOR, trará sua oferta do sacrifício de suas pazes ao SENHOR;
verses.en_web: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.en_bbe: Say to the children of Israel: He who makes a peace-offering to the Lord, is to give an offering to the Lord out of his peace-offering:

verses.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.pt: Suas mãos trarão as ofertas que se hão de queimar ao SENHOR: trará a gordura com o peito: o peito para que este seja movido, como sacrifício movido diante do SENHOR;
verses.en_web: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: He himself is to take to the Lord the offering made by fire, even the fat with the breast, so that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.

verses.en: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.pt: E a gordura a fará arder o sacerdote no altar, mas o peito será de Arão e de seus filhos.
verses.en_web: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.
verses.en_bbe: And the fat is to be burned by the priest on the altar, but the breast is for Aaron and his sons.

verses.en: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.pt: E dareis ao sacerdote para ser elevada em oferta, a coxa direita dos sacrifícios de vossas pazes.
verses.en_web: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.en_bbe: And the right leg you are to give to the priest for an offering to be lifted up out of what is given for your peace-offerings.

verses.en: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
verses.pt: O que dos filhos de Arão oferecer o sangue das ofertas pacíficas, e a gordura, dele será em porção a coxa direita;
verses.en_web: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.
verses.en_bbe: That man, among the sons of Aaron, by whom the blood of the peace-offering and the fat are offered, is to have the right leg for his part.

verses.en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Porque tomei dos filhos de Israel, dos sacrifícios de suas ofertas pacíficas, o peito que é movido, e a coxa elevada em oferta, e o dei a Arão o sacerdote e a seus filhos, por estatuto perpétuo dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”
verses.en_bbe: For the breast which is waved and the right leg which is lifted up on high I have taken from the children of Israel, from their peace-offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their right for ever from the children of Israel.

verses.en: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest’s office;
verses.pt: Esta é pela unção de Arão e a unção de seus filhos, a parte deles nas ofertas acendidas ao SENHOR, desde o dia que ele os apresentou para serem sacerdotes do SENHOR:
verses.en_web: This is the anointing portion of Aaron, and the anointing portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;
verses.en_bbe: This is the holy part given to Aaron and to his sons, out of the offerings made to the Lord by fire, on the day when they were made priests before the Lord;

verses.en: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
verses.pt: O qual mandou o SENHOR que lhes dessem, desde o dia que ele os ungiu dentre os filhos de Israel, por estatuto perpétuo em suas gerações.
verses.en_web: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.
verses.en_bbe: Which the Lord said the children of Israel were to give them, on the day when he made them his priests. It is their right for ever from generation to generation.

verses.en: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.pt: Esta é a lei do holocausto, da oferta, da expiação pelo pecado, e da culpa, e das consagrações, e do sacrifício pacífico:
verses.en_web: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meal offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of peace offerings;
verses.en_bbe: These are the laws for the burned offering, the meal offering, and the offering for wrongdoing; and for the making of priests, and for the giving of peace-offerings;

verses.en: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.pt: A qual intimou o SENHOR a Moisés, no monte Sinai, no dia que mandou aos filhos de Israel que oferecessem suas ofertas ao SENHOR no deserto de Sinai.
verses.en_web: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.en_bbe: As they were given by the Lord to Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day when the Lord gave orders to the children of Israel to make their offerings to the Lord, in the waste land of Sinai.
